Pakistan ke Jhang mein ek real Pakistani farmhouse ki zindagi ko itne kareeb se dekhne ka mauka mila — horse breeding, dairy farming, seed breeding aur rural life, sab kuch ek hi jagah!
Is vlog mein hum apne doston ke farm par gaye, jahan unhone humein apne horses, mares, foals, cows, dogs, peacocks aur partridges dikhaye. Farm par ek khaas pedigree breeding horse bhi tha, jiski height aur personality dekhne layak thi.
